SELECT pr.*, s.supplier_name AS supplier_name, pp.plan_name AS plan_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(d.amount) FROM purchase_request_detail d WHERE d.request_id = pr.id), 0) AS total_amount FROM purchase_request pr LEFT JOIN supplier s ON pr.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN purchase_plan pp ON pr.plan_id = pp.id
AND pr.request_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND pr.status = #{status}
ORDER BY pr.create_time DESC
